orientation_convention: source axes +X=patient left, -X=patient right, +Y=posterior, +Z=base/superior, -Z=apex/inferior; AR export remaps to +X=patient left, -X=patient right, +Y=anterior/screen-up, -Y=posterior/screen-down, -Z=apex/front/user side, +Z=base/back
ablr_markers: A=apex/front, B=base/back; side labels use the apex-facing lithotomy screen convention: R appears viewer-left, L appears viewer-right; hide nodes/meshes named orientation_* or AR_orientation_markers to toggle

triangle_budget.reason: 30k-80k triangles keeps phone AR smooth while preserving gland/zonal shape.
